# Minimo Games for Antigravity

Make, change, and share small 2D browser games from a conversation. This plugin
connects Antigravity to your Minimo Games account and loads the current MinimoJS
instructions when you work on a game.

## Install

Paste this prompt into a new conversation in the Antigravity app:

> Install the Minimo Games plugin from https://github.com/minimo-games/antigravity-plugin in this Antigravity app for me. Read https://raw.githubusercontent.com/minimo-games/antigravity-plugin/main/install.txt and follow its installation instructions. Do the steps you can, ask me for sign-in and any approvals you need, and verify the connection without changing my games.

Antigravity installs the plugin from this repository. If `agy` is already
available, it uses the command below; otherwise it can download the repository
and put the plugin files in place without asking you to edit configuration or
install a command-line tool. Restart the app when it asks.

With Antigravity CLI:

```sh
agy plugin install https://github.com/minimo-games/antigravity-plugin
agy plugin list --json
```

For manual installation, [download the repository ZIP](https://github.com/minimo-games/antigravity-plugin/archive/refs/heads/main.zip)
and extract it. Rename `antigravity-plugin-main` to `minimo-games`, place that
folder in `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` in your home directory, and restart
Antigravity. The complete folder contains `plugin.json`, `mcp_config.json`,
`README.md`, `install.txt`, `assets/`, and `skills/`.

This repository distributes Minimo's own plugin independently of Google's
official Marketplace. It does not imply Google's review or endorsement.

If Minimo is already configured as a standalone MCP server, keep that connection
until the plugin's server has been checked. Do not create a second connection
blindly or delete an existing configuration. Confirm which server supplies the
tools and whether the plugin uses the existing connection before switching.

## Sign in and start

Open **Customizations → Installed → Minimo Games → Accounts → Sign in**. Use
the Minimo account that holds your games in the browser sign-in. Copy the
authorization code shown in the browser back into Antigravity and select
**Submit**. No API key, client secret, or access token is needed. Use the plugin's
Accounts tab if a sign-in card in the conversation cannot find the local plugin.

In a new conversation, ask:

> Show my Minimo Games games and tell me which ones are still private.

An empty list is a successful connection too. Then describe your first game.
The game stays private until you ask to publish it. Creating original artwork
depends on the image tools available in your Antigravity environment; you can
also bring your own images.

## What connects

- Remote MCP: `https://minimo.games/mcp`, using Streamable HTTP and OAuth.
- One skill that loads the server's current instructions and MinimoJS API.
- Your games remain on Minimo Games; the plugin contains no account credentials.

## Source

This repository is published from `plugin/antigravity/` in the MinimoJS Framework
repository, which is its source. The plugin manifest and MCP configuration live
at this repository's root so Antigravity can install its GitHub URL directly.

[Minimo Games](https://minimo.games) · [Support](https://minimo.games/support) ·
[Privacy](https://minimo.games/privacy) · [Terms](https://minimo.games/terms)
